## Summary

Consider that the KA24DE in a 2WD Xterra weighs around 3,500 lbs with a manual transmission. [t1907]

## Specifications

- **KA24DE horsepower**: ~145hp [t1907] ([Unverified] single report)
- **VG33E horsepower (Gen 1.5)**: 180hp [t1907] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Consider that the KA24DE in a 2WD Xterra weighs around 3,500 lbs with a manual transmission. [t1907]
- [Partial] Add approximately 100 lbs for 4WD components when calculating power needs. [t1907]
